type.notes: Verified on real sheets 2026-11-15: HP Color LaserJet, tray 1, check print with correction. The earlier geometry (top margin 13.5 mm, rows 10.0 mm) put every row line 0.7–1.3 mm low; corrected to top 12.54 mm and 9.98 mm rows. Vendor page not reachable; values agree between two third-party sources for this size (Labelplanet LP189/25, MR-Label MR111, listed there as the L4731 size; second source: http://mr-label.com/articles/3884). Corner radius 1.47 mm from MR-Label MR111, rounded to 1.5. No vertical gap (pitch 10 = label height). Material: removable.
